Yungee is a local IT business founded by Kevin Pena. The idea is straightforward: be the person businesses can call when the tech needs attention.

My background is in systems administration and hands-on support—networks, computers, cameras, kiosks, printers, and the little things that can bring a busy day to a stop.

I like figuring out why something isn’t working, fixing the cause, and leaving it easier to manage than I found it. That’s the approach I bring to Yungee.

Ask about your location

A few things you might ask

Before we
get started.

Can you help with a one-time problem?

Yes. You can reach out for a single repair, an installation, or a project. Tell us what you need and we’ll discuss the right scope.

I don’t know what’s causing the issue. Is that okay?

Absolutely. Describe what you’re seeing and when it happens. Photos, error messages, and the equipment model can help, but you don’t need a diagnosis to get in touch.

Can you work with the equipment I already have?

That’s where we start. We’ll look at what you have, what’s causing trouble, and whether it can do what you need before suggesting replacements.

How much will it cost?

It depends on the issue, the equipment, and the work involved. Send a few details and we’ll follow up to discuss the scope and pricing before you commit.

Do you offer on-site and remote support?

Both. Some problems can be handled remotely. Cabling, physical installation, and hands-on troubleshooting need a visit. We’ll work out the best approach together.
